file_type: PE32+ (x86-64) Windows console executable (MinGW-w64 GCC 13, debug info left in binary as DWARF sections)

encryption_details.key_storage: Hardcoded 16-byte global g_rc4_key in .rdata at RVA 0x5000 (file offset 0x2a00), passed to rc4_init() with keylen 0x10; used to decrypt the 48-byte (0x30) g_encrypted_shellcode buffer in-place via rc4_crypt().

decoded_strings.ntdll.dll: module resolved at runtime with GetModuleHandleA
decoded_strings.NtOpenProcess: resolved via GetProcAddress for process handle
decoded_strings.NtQueueApcThread: queues APC to suspended target thread
decoded_strings.g_encrypted_shellcode: 48-byte RC4 blob at RVA 0x4000 (see encryption_details); plaintext not statically recovered

anti_analysis: Payload encryption: 48-byte shellcode (g_encrypted_shellcode) stored RC4-encrypted and decrypted only at runtime on the stack

Dynamic NT API resolution: injection APIs (NtOpenProcess, NtClose, NtQueryInformationProcess, NtAllocateVirtualMemory, NtWriteVirtualMemory, NtQueueApcThread, NtAlertResumeThread) are resolved at runtime via GetModuleHandleA('ntdll.dll') + GetProcAddress (resolve_nt), so ntdll never appears in the import table
Anti-debug heuristic: NtQueryInformationProcess(ProcessDebugPort, class 7) on own process; injection aborts if returned debug port equals 0xFFFFFFFF
Suspends a thread of the current process (SuspendThread) before queuing the APC so the payload runs in an alertable/wait state
Debug-symbol/type info left in the binary (DWARF), which is an opsec failure rather than a technique

injection_details.method: Early-bird/APC injection (self-injection): NtOpenProcess(self) -> NtAllocateVirtualMemory(MEM_COMMIT|MEM_RESERVE, PAGE_EXECUTE_READWRITE) -> NtWriteVirtualMemory -> NtQueueApcThread -> NtAlertResumeThread; then NtClose on both handles and Sleep(500ms)
injection_details.target_process: Itself (current process) - PID obtained via GetCurrentProcessId()
injection_details.target_discovery: find_target_thread(): CreateToolhelp32Snapshot(TH32CS_SNAPTHREAD,0) + Thread32First/Thread32Next, selecting the first thread whose th32OwnerProcessID equals the current PID, then OpenThread(0x12 = THREAD_SUSPEND_RESUME|THREAD_SET_CONTEXT) and SuspendThread
injection_details.payload: 48-byte RC4-encrypted shellcode at .data RVA 0x4000, decrypted in-place with the 16-byte RC4 key and written to the newly allocated RWX region
injection_details.source_file: windows_level15_APCInjection.c (function names rc4_init/rc4_crypt/resolve_nt/find_target_thread/apc_inject recovered from embedded DWARF symbols)
